intro.text: A close friend of Cakoban the Navigator, and one of his last two companions on a voyage through the endless dark.

items.text: After their people had reached their new home, Jope sailed on with Cakoban. A creature drawn to their Investiture hunted them for weeks while they went without food, until Cakoban gave his life so that Jope and their shipmate could get away.
Jope could see the fear behind Cakoban's bravado, but Cakoban told him to tell the tale more bravely once he was back among their people. Jope was also courting Cakoban's sister.

appearance.text: Goes shirtless, in a wrap and loincloth.

items.text: Has a mindshield of some kind.
